verdict.rationale: GitLab documents an extensive REST/GraphQL API ('Interact programmatically with GitLab'), token/SSH auth, an official CLI, and even an MCP server, suggesting broad UI/API parity, but no evidence explicitly confirms 100% feature parity or addresses known API gaps for specific settings/actions. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or audit showing every UI action has an API equivalent, and independent/community confirmation of completeness.
